issues.description: The problem statement and solution refer to a function named make_y_state(circ, q, p), but the template defines a function named create_y_state(...) (and its NotImplementedError message references make_y_state). This naming mismatch will confuse students searching for the function they are asked to implement and prevents a direct, unambiguous mapping from the task description to the template stub.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template stub create_y_state(...) to make_y_state(...) (and update its NotImplementedError message) so the template function name matches the problem statement and the expected solution. Alternatively, update the problem statement and tests to refer to create_y_state if that name was intended.
